{{quote|There is among the Maidens of the Spear in the Stone of Tear a willful girl called [[Aviendha]], of the Nine Valleys sept of the Taardad Aiel. She must now come to us. There can be no more waiting or excuses.| Letter to [[Moiraine]] from [[Amys]], [[Bair]], [[Melaine]] and [[Seana]]}}

==Summary==
: {{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

[[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]], [[Nynaeve]] and [[Aviendha]] are relieved when [[Egwene]] awakens from ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', as they had been unable to wake her when the time came. Nynaeve was about to empty a pitcher of water on her. Egwene tells them how the [[Wise One]] [[Amys]] told her to come to [[Cold Rocks Hold]] in the [[Aiel Waste]] to learn. Although agitated, Aviendha explains that Amys was once ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' until she gave up the spear to go to [[Rhuidean]], and that she is [[Rhuarc]]'s wife as well as [[sister-wife]] to [[Lian]] (who is Aviendha's [[sister-mother]]). This confuses the girls and shocks them when they finally understand that Rhuarc has two wives. Egwene dismisses Aviendha's suggestion of her and Elayne becoming sister-wives to Rand, but Elayne is reminded of [[Min]]'s viewing about her sharing her husband with two other women.{{ref/book|2|24}}{{ref|Elayne is oblivious that Min is one of those women, and the other, Aviendha, is right in front of her.}} Egwene further explains that Amys sensed an evil in [[Tanchico]], which could possibly be the [[Black Ajah]].

Egwene has decided that she needs to go to the Waste to seek Amys, with Aviendha as her guide, and offers to leave the [[twisted stone ring]] with the other two girls so they can meet in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' in the [[Stone of Tear]] to teach them what she learns. Elayne and then Nynaeve agree she must go, and that they will travel to Tanchico. Aviendha has no chance to voice her opinion before [[Moiraine]] enters and announces that [[Joiya]] and [[Amico]] are dead, apparently killed by something of the [[Shadow]] during the [[Trolloc]] attack on the Stone.{{ref|This is later revealed to be [[Slayer]] as [[Isam]]. ({{9|22}}; {{twotc}}, Joiya Byir)}} The prison guards stayed at their posts during the attack and saw nothing, but afterwards the women were found with their throats cut after their tongues had been nailed to their cell doors.

Nynaeve informs Moiraine that she and Elayne will go to Tanchico by ship while Egwene and Aviendha go to Cold Rocks hold in the Waste. Aviendha declines, saying a different Maiden can escort Egwene while making excuses as to why she should instead go with Elayne and Nynaeve. But Moiraine takes out a letter she had just received from Wise Ones [[Amys]], [[Bair]], [[Melaine]] and [[Seana]]. The letter is addressed to her in the Stone and was written a month ago, before the party had even reached Tear. Aviendha says the named Wise Ones are all [[Dreamwalking|Dreamwalkers]] and Moiraine muses that may be why they knew to send this letter. The Wise Ones say that Aviendha must come to [[Chaendaer]], above [[Rhuidean]], without delay. Aviendha angrily protests that she is ''Far Dareis Mai'' and will go to Tanchico if she wishes, but Moiraine tells her that, following the letter's instructions, she had showed the letter to Rhuarc.{{ref|Rhuarc as the [[clan chief]] will carry out the Wise Ones' wishes.}} After Aviendha stalks out of the room angrily, Moiraine refuses to reveal why the Wise Ones wanted Aviendha as it is not their business.{{ref|She is to go to Rhuidean and train as a Wise One, and will have to give up the spear, much like Amys.}} 

Moiraine tells the girls that there is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' ship at the docks in the [[Maule]] in Tear which would be ideal for a fast voyage to Tanchico. Elayne ponders what [[Rand]] will do when she tells him she is leaving for Tanchico.
